title: Reporting Subscription State
description: Seller readback for one principal-level reporting subscription (experimental, media_buy.reporting_subscriptions). Per-account coverage, exclusions, and revocations are read through get_reporting_status subscription_coverage, not here.

state.description: active: accepted and resolving per account. inactive: the caller set active false. action_required: the subscription cannot deliver anywhere until the caller acts, for example because its destination is suspended or not ready; issues names the cause.

accepted_at.description: When the seller accepted the current subscription_version. It is the earliest possible covered_from for coverage that version starts.

deactivated_at.description: When active false was applied. Present when and only when state is inactive.

destination_ref.description: Destination generation currently bound. Present when and only when the configuration names a destination.

configuration.description: Desired configuration currently associated with this subscription.

issues.description: Structured issues. Messages are untrusted display data.
